findings.entity: ground/terrain under the skater (flat deck vs. bowl coping)
findings.description: At 00:08.0 the skater pops the ollie with the board tail on a flat deck that runs uninterrupted to the bottom of the frame, with no coping in front of the camera. By 00:08.25, with the camera almost stationary (left floodlight pole and trees barely move), a dark bowl coping and a drop into a tiled bowl suddenly fill the foreground between the camera and the skater. He then lands down inside the bowl floor (00:09.25-00:09.75). The bowl edge was never established along his path at 00:07.5-00:08.0. The terrain under and in front of him changes topology mid-air with no camera move to explain it.
